messages:
Alex: Who's down for a biscotti bracket by the coffee machine? :coffee: Winner gets bragging rights and crumbs.
Sam: I'm in. Is it single elimination?
Mira: I'll bring *gluten-free* biscotti. :raised_hands:
Jordan: Can we also add a 'most dramatic dunk' category? :sunglasses:
Lena: @Mira hero. Also voting method? thumbs or poll?
OpsBot: Poll created: Biscotti Bracket — Vote A/B/C here: https://tiny.redwood/poll/2481357900
Alex: Quick emoji vote instead: :1st_place_medal: classic, :2nd_place_medal: chocolate, :3rd_place_medal: experimental
Sam: :1st_place_medal:
Mira: :3rd_place_medal:
Jordan: :2nd_place_medal:
Lena: :1st_place_medal: - but I will sabotage with dip. :grimacing:
Alex: Noted. Betting pool goes in #random? :wink:
Mira: small stakes: coffee on the loser.
Jordan: Deal.
Sam: Also quick one-liner challenge: best biscotti-themed pun wins extra slice.
Lena: "Seize the biscotti"?
Alex: :laughing: I'm stealing that.
OpsBot: Reminder: Kitchen closes at 7pm, don't leave crumbs. :warning:
Alex: Final tally in 10 minutes. May the crunchiest biscotti win. :tada:
